newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danisco full-year profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danisco full-year profit seen up.

text.p: Danish sugar and distilling group Danisco is expected to report pre-tax profit up by 12.7 percent when it publishes its 1996/97 full-year results on Wednesday, according to an average of eight analysts' forecasts.
They predicted, on average, profit of 1.807 billion crowns, compared to 1.604 for the preceeding 12 months.
Forecasts ranged from a low of 1.737 billion crowns to a high of 1.857 billion.
Turnover was seen growing more slowly, with an average forecast of an 8.7 percent rise to 17.590 billion crowns from 16.186 billion.
Despite the expectations the firm's share was down 3.0 crowns to 430.00 crowns on Tuesday, although the Copenhagen market was generally slightly depressed by Monday's falling U.S. share prices.
